title: Normalized slice restriction preserves Koszul exchange
statement: Under the independent-universe ringed-site hypotheses and closed tensor-Hom structures S,S_U with representative models T,T_U [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model], let d be comparison data satisfying the four normalizations [def-sfb-ringed-slice-comparison-model]. For arbitrary L,M in D(A), r(sigma(L,M)) followed by rho(M,L) equals rho(L,M) followed by sigma_U(rL,rM). The proof uses no evaluation or transposition identity.

source.place: Tags 06YN and 07A4; direct comparison of the two signed exchanges on total-complex summands.

proof.text: On flat-term K-flat representatives P,Q, use the tensor normalization to obtain gamma and gamma-prime, and the two Koszul normalizations to obtain beta and beta_U. After precomposing by gamma inverse compare chain maps out of Tot(rP tensor rQ). HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor.hom_ext, the sheafification adjunction and ModuleCat tensor extensionality reduce equality to local pure tensors. The gamma inverse formula follows by applying gamma inverse to the gamma generator formula. Both composites then give (-1)^(pq) times the reversed generator, proving r(beta) composed with gamma-prime = gamma composed with beta_U.

Apply the representative localization squares for rho and sigma on each site. Naturality of the exact restriction localization isomorphism and functoriality of Q turn the chain-map square into the symmetry square on QP,QQ. Cancel only the tensor model isomorphisms and the tensor of the two localization isomorphisms. This is the categorical helper symmetry_of_models in Lean.

Choose flat-term K-flat resolutions mapping quasi-isomorphically to arbitrary complex representatives of L,M. Q sends these maps to isomorphisms. Convert the exact-tensor-right term property of the resolution theorem to IsFlatOnSite using siteSheafTensorRightIso. Naturality of rho, sigma and sigma_U transports the proved square along the resulting isomorphisms QP≅L and QQ≅M. No symmetry or evaluation map is cancelled.

lean.statement:
theorem ringedSlice_koszul_coherence
    (U : C) [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (SheafOfModules.{max c v u} ((sheafCompose (J.over U) (forget₂
      CommRingCat.{max c v u} RingCat.{max c v u})).obj (A.over U)))]
    (S : CoefficientClosedStructure (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, u, w} J A))
    (T : CoefficientTensorModels.{u, c, v, w} J A S)
    (SU : CoefficientClosedStructure
      (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{max c v, v, u, w'} (J.over U) (A.over U)))
    (TU : CoefficientTensorModels.{u, max c v, v, w'} (J.over U) (A.over U) SU)
    (d : RingedSliceEvaluationComparisons (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, u, w} J A)
      (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{max c v, v, u, w'} (J.over U) (A.over U))
      (ringedSliceDerivedRestriction.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U) S SU
      (RingedSliceFlatRestriction.{c, v, u} J A U))
    (hd : RingedSliceEvaluationNormalized.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U S T SU TU d)
    (L M : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{max c v u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂
      CommRingCat.{max c v u} RingCat.{max c v u})).obj A))) :
    (ringedSliceDerivedRestriction.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U).map (d.sigma L M).hom ≫
        (d.rho M L).hom =
      (d.rho L M).hom ≫
        (d.sigmaU ((ringedSliceDerivedRestriction.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U).obj L)
          ((ringedSliceDerivedRestriction.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U).obj M)).hom
